rows.note: Use 電話 as the all-purpose noun for a phone call, including an attempted call.

example.english: I made a call to you just now.
example.traditional: 我頭先打咗個電話畀你。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tau4 sin1 daa2 zo2 go3 din6 waa2 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use 通話 when emphasizing the actual telephone conversation or connected communication rather than merely making a call.

example.english: Our call lasted half an hour.
example.traditional: 我哋嘅通話維持咗半個鐘。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ge3 tung1 waa2 wai4 ci4 zo2 bun3 go3 zung1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for contacting someone by telephone.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zan6 gaan1 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use 叫 when giving someone a name or saying what a person or thing is called, including the casual pattern 叫我 Al.
Use this when loosely characterizing or estimating something rather than stating an exact fact.

example.english: You can call this good news.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 syun3 hai6 hou2 siu1 sik1 laa3
